replies.text:
I worked with a ton of Bosniak (as well as a few Serb and Croat) refugees as well, from 2004 to 2020. One of them is my best friend to this day. He's a brilliant guy. He speaks four or five languages fluently, is a brilliant artist (from cartoons to oil paintings), never goes anywhere without a book, and most importantly, loves soccer even more than me. My long-winded point being that the stories he's told me about life as a Bosniak during the war are harrowing, to say the least. 
This video was amusing, and I'm not really one to get offended by silliness, but I was definitely squirming a bit on the inside.
